name: openquatt
description: OpenQuatt firmware and embedded web UI tooling

scripts.check:docs: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 scripts/check_docs_consistency.py && node scripts/check_web_docs_sync.mjs
scripts.check:web: node openquatt/web/build-assets.mjs --check && node --test openquatt/web/tests/*.test.mjs && node openquatt/web/check-web-quality.mjs
scripts.setup:git-merge-driver: git config --local merge.openquatt-generated.name "Keep current generated web bundle for rebuild" && git config --local merge.openquatt-generated.driver true && git config --local merge.openquatt-generated.recursive binary
